# namespace_registry_shared_image (Resource)

Manages a Namespace Cloud container image share reference. Creating this resource exposes a container image publicly or to partners via a dedicated share URL. Import is intentionally unsupported because the API does not return the original source repository needed to reconstruct configuration losslessly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

resource "namespace_registry_shared_image" "public_release" {
  repository = "my-org/app"
  digest     = "sha256:e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855"
  visibility = "PUBLIC"
  expires_at = "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z"
  suffix     = "v1-prod"
}

output "public_image_ref" {
  value = namespace_registry_shared_image.public_release.image_ref
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `digest` (String) Source image manifest digest (e.g. `sha256:...`). Changing this forces recreation.
- `repository` (String) Source container image repository name. Changing this forces recreation.
- `visibility` (String) Access visibility (`PUBLIC` or `PARTNER`). Changing this forces recreation.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) RFC3339Nano expiration timestamp after which the share is automatically revoked. Changing this forces recreation.
- `suffix` (String) Optional URL disambiguation suffix for the public pull reference. Changing this forces recreation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique server-assigned identifier for the shared image.
- `image_ref` (String) Full public pull reference URL for the shared container image.
- `shared_digest` (String) Server-assigned shared image digest.
- `shared_repository` (String) Server-assigned shared repository name.
